scenarios.prompt: A gate depends on one capability plus a story predicate. Resolve from authoritative stable IDs and update deterministically when either owner changes.

criteria.ownership: Gate consumes capability and story state but does not own tutorials, map, or saves.
criteria.predicate: Gate ID, predicate IDs and version, and result are explicit.
criteria.evidence: Duplicate or stale notifications cannot override newer authoritative state.
